en: The name you give a Mac now shows in titles, Dock icons and alerts too, not just the sidebar.
Apps looks like macOS's Apps view, Windows can show all windows as in Mission Control, and search filters as you type, including pinyin.
zh-Hans: 你给 Mac 起的名字现在也会显示在标题、Dock 图标和提示中，而不只是边栏。
“App”页面改成 macOS“App”视图的样式，“窗口”页面可以像调度中心一样显示所有窗口，搜索会随输入实时筛选，也支持拼音。
